Register Field Explanation: ADMA Length Mismatch Error: This error occurs in the following 2 cases: (1) While Block Count Enable being set, the total data length specified by the Descriptor table is different from that specified by the Block Count and Block Length. (2) Total data length can not be divided by the block length. 1=Error, 0=No Error
ADMA Error State: This field indicates the state of ADMA when error is occurred during ADMA data transfer. This field never indicates 10 because ADMA never stops in this state.
ST_STOP (Stop DMA),Points next of the error descriptor
ST_TFR (Transfer Data),Points the next of the error descriptor
